title: General Rodent Tattoo System
summary: Permanent tail identification for weanling and adult mice and rats.
description: Designed for breeding-colony records and individual experimental identification, the ATS-3 marks mouse and rat tails with permanent numbers, letters or lines. It serves weanling and adult rodents, with dedicated supplies and restraints. An existing system can be extended to neonates or larger laboratory animals using the packages in the Cat.No selector.
features: Laboratory-duty equipment for rodent tail identification
Dedicated tail needles and a choice of pigment colors
Permanent markings for colony and research records
RoHS compliance listed by the manufacturer
specifications: Numbers, letters, lines, dots and colors
NEO-AP for neonates; LLA-AP for larger animals

models.title: General Rodent Tattoo System
models.description: Complete rodent tattoo system with supplies and accessories.

models.title: Neonate Upgrade Package
models.description: Neonate accessories and supplies for an existing ATS-3; includes the neonate tattoo guide.

models.title: Large Lab Animal Upgrade Package
models.description: Large-animal accessories and supplies for an existing ATS-3; includes the large-animal tattoo guide.

applications: Weanling and adult mice and rats, including different coat colors and strains.
Tail markings for breeding colonies and individual animals in experiments.
Numbers, letters, lines, dots and pigment colors can form identification schemes.
kitContents: Rodent tattoo system with mouse / rat restraints
Tattoo pigments, tail needles and accessories
Approximately 3,000 mice / rats, as stated in the 2022 brochure
capacityNote: The brochure gives an approximate initial supply capacity; consumption depends on the identification scheme and use.

training.description: Equipment setup and operation instructions accompany a rodent training guide and instructional DVD, as listed in the brochure. The guide covers tail-marking techniques.
training.upgradeNote: NEO-AP includes the Vol. 1 neonate guide; LLA-AP includes the Vol. 3 large-animal guide.

title: Neonate Rodent Tattooing System
summary: An identification system developed for newborn mice and rats from P0 to P15.
description: The NEO-9 identifies mice and rats from birth through P15, across coat colors and strains. Early individual identification supports neonatal studies and transgenic-colony records before weaning. The system combines dedicated tattoo equipment with a lighted, magnified work station and illustrated identification schemes.
features: Designed specifically for P0–P15 mice and rats
Illuminated micro tattooing station with 4× magnification
Identification schemes covering small and large number ranges
Numbering schemes supporting up to 10,000 unique IDs
Choice of pigment colors for different neonates
specifications: Toes, paw pads, leg shanks and tail
Schemes for up to 10,000 unique numbers

models.title: Neonate Rodent Tattooing System
models.description: Neonate tattoo system with supplies, accessories and training documentation.

applications: Individual identification beginning on the first day of life (P0).
Transgenic-colony records and early genotyping studies before weaning.
Manufacturer-listed sites: toes, paw pads, leg shanks and tail. Existing toe-numbering schemes can be adapted to tattoo markings.
kitContents: Neonate tattoo system with LED-lit micro tattooing station
Approximately 2,000 neonates, as stated in the 2022 brochure
capacityNote: The brochure gives an approximate initial supply capacity; consumption depends on the identification scheme and use.

training.description: The illustrated training guide and instructional DVD explain neonate identification schemes. Separate equipment instructions cover setup, operation and care.
training.upgradeNote: For an existing ATS-3, the NEO-AP package adds neonate accessories, supplies and the Vol. 1 guide.

title: Large Lab Animal Tattoo System
summary: Compact tattoo equipment for skin identification on larger laboratory animals.
description: The ATS-3L provides skin identification for larger laboratory animals, including rabbits, hamsters, guinea pigs, ferrets, nonhuman primates, swine, cats and dogs. Its lightweight handpiece and compact power / control equipment suit limited work areas. It can also mark injection or treatment locations on laboratory-animal skin.
features: Foot pedal for on / off control
Compact micro-power supply and tattoo controller
Calibrated small- and large-bore needle tubes
Dedicated needles for different line sizes
specifications: Rabbits, hamsters, guinea pigs, ferrets, NHP, swine, cats and dogs
Ears, chest, inner biceps, thighs and other skin sites

models.title: Large Lab Animal Tattoo System
models.description: Large laboratory animal tattoo system with supplies and accessories.

applications: Individual identification of larger laboratory animals.
Common sites include ears, chest, inner biceps and thighs.
Marking injection and treatment locations on skin.
kitContents: HDUI compact micro-power supply, controller and foot pedal
Calibrated small- / large-bore tubes and large-animal needles

training.description: The supplied guide covers large-animal skin identification. Equipment instructions explain setup and operation; the brochure also describes cleaning and sterilization between animals.
training.upgradeNote: For an existing ATS-3, the LLA-AP package adds large-animal accessories, supplies and the Vol. 3 guide.
